deepening.explanation: Establishes breakthrough through risk rather than guaranteed penetration.

nodes.name: Open-lane charge
nodes.description: The entry proceeds only while the observed route remains clear. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a route and visibility condition.

nodes.name: Break and return
nodes.description: A successful entry links to a retreating cut that restores distance. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines commitment with a separate exit plan.

nodes.name: Body or weapon line
nodes.description: The user chooses direct collision pressure or a narrower blade line. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Creates a tactical risk and target-shape fork.

nodes.name: Boar through the gate
nodes.description: Stamina and recovery are spent to challenge one defended opening. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes in one lane while remaining vulnerable to sidestep.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires a clear straight route and leaves long recovery on miss.

nodes.name: Life-on-the-edge passage
nodes.description: One maximum-commitment entry seeks a decisive exchange then ends the sequence. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Caps the branch with explicit cost and failure exposure, not an absolute hit.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Consumes substantial stamina, cannot redirect after launch and exposes the user if blocked or evaded.

nodes.name: Receiving blade
nodes.description: A compact guard seeks to reduce one incoming melee exchange. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes defense with direction and timing limits.

nodes.name: Firm receive
nodes.description: A correctly faced contact preserves posture for a later action. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds facing and contact conditions.

nodes.name: Receive and answer
nodes.description: A successful receive links to a separately timed counter cut. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines guard and response without automatic retaliation.

nodes.name: Guard high or low
nodes.description: The user chooses which visible attack line to cover. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Makes defense a tactical coverage choice.

nodes.name: Hound at the gate
nodes.description: Repeated guarded responses hold a lane but yield flanking space. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes in frontal defense with an explicit side weakness.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Covers one facing sector and consumes stamina on contact.

nodes.name: Faithful last answer
nodes.description: A final guarded response commits remaining stamina to one counter. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines receive and counter while preserving range and direction counters.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires a successful guard, spends remaining reserve and cannot answer attacks outside the sector.

nodes.name: Turning sweep
nodes.description: A broad cut contests nearby lateral space. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes area control through blade geometry.

nodes.name: Wall-side sweep
nodes.description: The sweep is strongest when terrain removes one escape side. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a terrain and positioning condition.

nodes.name: Crossing arcs
nodes.description: Two differently timed arcs cover approach then retreat. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines shapes while preserving gaps between them.

nodes.name: Open or closed circle
nodes.description: The user chooses a full sweep or a shorter guarded arc. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a tactical coverage-versus-recovery choice.

nodes.name: Dragon perimeter
nodes.description: Sustained arcs defend a small perimeter but consume movement freedom. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes in holding local space rather than chasing.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires room to rotate and prevents fast pursuit during the sequence.

nodes.name: Heaven-turning ring
nodes.description: A committed final rotation pressures every clear nearby lane once. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Maximizes bounded local coverage while retaining terrain and recovery counters.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Long active time, stamina cost and recovery; walls and distance remain effective.

nodes.name: Measured cut
nodes.description: A conservative cut preserves room to recover stamina. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes efficiency by lowering commitment, not increasing power.

nodes.name: Breath interval
nodes.description: Completing a quiet recovery interval prepares the next exchange. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a no-attack condition to resource recovery.

nodes.name: Cut and settle
nodes.description: A light attack is paired with a deliberate recovery beat. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines offense and resource timing without making either free.

nodes.name: Fast or frugal rhythm
nodes.description: The user chooses pressure cadence or stamina-preserving cadence. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Creates an explicit tactical resource mode.

nodes.name: Unbroken breath
nodes.description: A maintained rhythm reduces waste until movement or impact disrupts it. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes in stable exchanges while remaining vulnerable to disruption.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Ends on forced movement, heavy impact or cadence break.

nodes.name: Goat-cloud rhythm
nodes.description: A complete breath cycle supports one extended attack-and-guard sequence. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines resource control with continuity but never restores spent time.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires preparation without interruption and imposes a cooldown after the sequence.

nodes.name: Passing cut
nodes.description: A cut is delivered while continuing through the engagement. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes mobility without free turning or extra reach.

nodes.name: Stride timing
nodes.description: The passing cut gains a follow-up only after a legal advancing step. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a movement-completion condition.

nodes.name: Running exchange
nodes.description: Two cuts alternate across separate pursuit steps. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines attacks with bounded movement intervals.

nodes.name: Chase or cross
nodes.description: The user chooses direct pursuit or a lateral crossing route. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Turns mobility into a route tactic.

nodes.name: Relentless measure
nodes.description: Continued pursuit preserves pressure but steadily consumes stamina. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes in following a retreat without improving defense.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires visible route continuity and recurring stamina payment.

nodes.name: Thundering passage

deepening.explanation: Combines speed and timing while leaving turning and braking as counters.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Cannot turn sharply, is obstructed by terrain and has extended stopping recovery.

nodes.name: False opening
nodes.description: A readable first motion invites a response before the real cut. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes a feint that costs time and reveals intent.

nodes.name: Taken bait
nodes.description: The follow-up becomes available only after an observed defensive response. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds an observation-bound condition.

nodes.name: Feint and return
nodes.description: A false entry links to one of two later attack lines. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines deception with a bounded follow-up choice.

nodes.name: Changing guard
nodes.description: The user switches between attack invitation and defensive invitation. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Turns adaptation into a visible tactical mode.

nodes.name: Borrowed cadence
nodes.description: Repeated observation allows one response-timed variation. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes against a demonstrated cadence without reading hidden policy.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires delivered observations and expires when the cadence changes.

nodes.name: Hundred-face exchange

deepening.explanation: Combines learned observations without predicting future random choices.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: High decision and stamina cost; unknown responses and interruption defeat the sequence.

nodes.name: Rooted guard

deepening.explanation: Creates a patient guard whose value is time held, not extra damage.

nodes.name: Stored edge
nodes.description: A clean guarded interval prepares a stronger next entry. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a preparation condition that can be interrupted.

nodes.name: Guarded cadence

deepening.explanation: Combines stored posture with a later attack window.

nodes.name: Anchor stance
nodes.description: The user chooses stability against force or freedom to advance. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Makes accumulation a stance choice rather than a passive multiplier.

nodes.name: Patient pressure

deepening.explanation: Specializes in space denial while deliberately acting later.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires uninterrupted guard time and concedes immediate initiative.

nodes.name: Immovable edge

deepening.explanation: Links escape position to a separate counter opportunity.

nodes.name: Left-right withdrawal

deepening.explanation: Makes disengagement a route-selection tactic.

nodes.name: Vanishing measure

deepening.explanation: Specializes in leaving contact while surrendering the current exchange.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires a legal open route and forfeits immediate follow-up.

nodes.name: Hare across the blade

deepening.explanation: Combines evasion and repositioning without erasing collision or observation.

nodes.name: Opening cut

nodes.name: Committed opening cut

deepening.explanation: Adds resource readiness and approach distance to the foundation.

nodes.name: Opening return cut

deepening.explanation: Links two paid timings while leaving the single cut safer.

nodes.name: Advancing opening cut

deepening.explanation: Turns initiative into a positional approach mode.

nodes.name: Opening circle

deepening.explanation: Specializes the opener for surrounding space rather than a single target.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires stamina, cooldown and a long active sweep.

nodes.name: Watching point

deepening.explanation: Establishes observation as delayed evidence, not foreknowledge.

nodes.name: Read the shoulder
nodes.description: A clear delivered attack cue opens a narrow interception window. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds an observed-telegraph condition.

nodes.name: Read and return
nodes.description: A successful interception links to a separate restrained counter. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines defense and offense only after the read succeeds.

nodes.name: Near or far watch
nodes.description: The user chooses to watch weapon motion or approach movement. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Creates a tactical observation scope.

nodes.name: Clear-mirror guard
nodes.description: Sustained focus improves one class of read while slowing proactive attacks. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes in evidence quality at the cost of initiative.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires maintained visibility and forbids immediate proactive pressure.

nodes.name: Dawn interception
nodes.description: One fully observed commitment can be met by a decisive timed cut. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Caps the branch with an interruptible evidence-bound response.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: No effect against unseen or withheld actions; a false read causes full recovery exposure.

nodes.name: Checking edge
nodes.description: The blade occupies the direct route between opponent and user. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes restraint through threat position, not a hard stun.

nodes.name: Contact check
nodes.description: Meeting an opposing weapon briefly limits its immediate line. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a contact condition and finite duration.

nodes.name: Check and circle
nodes.description: A checked line is combined with a step toward the open side. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Links restraint to positioning rather than extra damage.

nodes.name: Bind or release
nodes.description: The user chooses to hold contact or release into a safer cut. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Creates a tactical commitment choice.

nodes.name: Coiling measure
nodes.description: Sustained contact taxes both users while narrowing escape. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes in pressure that the opponent can break by separating.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires maintained weapon contact and drains stamina from the holder.

nodes.name: Serpent lock line
nodes.description: A final bind attempts one controlled displacement before releasing. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a bounded payoff without converting restraint into indefinite capture.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Breaks on lost contact, costs stamina and cannot prevent attacks from other lines.

nodes.name: Driving cut
nodes.description: A committed cut pushes against a defended line. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes pressure through commitment instead of reach.

nodes.name: Edge bind
nodes.description: Contact with an active guard creates a brief follow-up opening. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Adds a defender-state condition to the driving cut.

nodes.name: Press and return
nodes.description: A driving cut is paired with a return strike after a successful bind. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Combines pressure and continuation only when contact was established.

nodes.name: High-low pressure
nodes.description: The user chooses a posture attack or a safer body line. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Turns the branch into a readable tactical fork.

nodes.name: Crushing measure
nodes.description: Close-range pressure spends stamina to contest a stable guard. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Specializes against braced defense while remaining poor at pursuit.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires close guarded contact and significant stamina.

nodes.name: Tiger gate break
nodes.description: A fully committed sequence attempts to open one defended lane. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Converts accumulated pressure into a finite break attempt, not universal penetration.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Long wind-up and recovery; failure leaves the user exposed and does not bypass barriers.
